name: @openclaw/tsa-budget-gate
description: TSA OpenClaw extension: per-tier budget gate (token/turn + request/month) with Postgres counters, Telegram alerts and Prometheus metrics. Pick A12 of Ace-TSIA v3.1.
author: TSA / Cadu Neiva <cadu@caduneiva.com>
comment_devDependencies_workspace: When dropped into the openclaw-tsa fork as extensions/tsa-budget-gate, add devDep "@openclaw/plugin-sdk": "workspace:*" — it resolves the openclaw/plugin-sdk/plugin-entry imports used by index.ts + src/plugin.ts. Locally we ship build:full disabled and rely on tsconfig.local.json which excludes those two files.
